title: Would give 5 star if it allows batch import from pdfs and from safari bookmarks
text:
I just purchased it and trying the functions, so far I like the concept that you can manage recipes, meal plans, grocery shopping all in one place. A few things can improve in order of priority preferences: 1. I like that they have a native browser where dozens of recipe websites to browse but I wish they would also allow to batch import bookmarks or bookmark folders from safari, and to allow import from PDFs so it’s easy to start using the app. There is “import recipe”in the setting,  further clicking “browse” button takes to the file folder but it would not recognize any recipes saved in pdf format, so not sure what exactly can be imported. It is painful to have to navigate to 100 recipe websites which I’ve already bookmarked overtime on the phone, to be able to save them to the app. 2. For the phone app, the menu bar is hidden and requires to click the 3 lines, I wish they are permanent icons at the top or bottom of the screen for easy navigation. 3. There should be some common pantry items that you can easily browse and select so you can setup an existing pantry in a few clicks. 4. It would be great if the app comes with some existing recipes already loaded, so one can start using the app right after downloading.
Hope these can be added to future updates and I’d gradly change my rating to 5 stars.

title: No support for issues
text:
I was excited about Paprika. It had good ratings in a lot of functionality.  I liked that it was available for both Mac and iOS and that it was a purchase rather than a subscription. The problem was with support. Shortly after I started using it, I ran into an issue that was not addressed in the user manual or the knowledge base. I posted a help request through the online portal, but no one ever bothered to reply. I can’t spend a lot of time learning an app if there is not going to be any support for problems. Initially, I had planned to buy the Mac app, but I’m glad that I bought the ISO app as a trial. I hope that I can get a refund for it.

Here is my issue. I added an item to the grocery list. Let’s say it was Water. I open the item and added a Note. After purchasing the Water, I checked it off and cleared it from the grocery list. The next time I added water to my grocery list, the Note field was empty. I could not find any way to save a Note. I can’t see the value of  a self clearing Note field. I don't know if this is by design or a bug.

When working on this issue I discovered a second issue. When I start to add a grocery item, Paprika populates a list of possible choices. If I enter “Milk” it gives me a list of items beginning with Milk, but the list does not include Soy Milk. If I enter “Milk S” the list includes all items beginning with  “S.” If I enter “Soy” the list includes Soy Milk and other items that begin with Soy. If I enter “Soy Milk” the list includes items that begin with Milk, but not Soy Milk. This is crazy!

text: I got this app so I didn’t have to dig through websites for recipes- turns out, I get an error every time I try to download one. Pretty excited for this but total disappointment. If I wanted to use the clipboard option I wouldn’t have spent money to copy and paste.

title: Had to buy a second time
text:
I’ve had this app for years and loved it. Then it stopped working, it would only show half the ingredients or half the directions. In order to see everything you have to look edit and re-save the recipe. 
I reached out to the developers who said the only way to work around it was to buy the new version of the app. So much for a one off payment…

title: Grave mancanza
text: Non scarica gli ingredienti dalle ricette di Giallo Zafferano, cosa che invece fanno tranquillamente altre app gratuite. Soldi buttati senza questo aggiornamento.
